title: Geodemaniacal Delights
description: Add-on that meshes Farmer's Delight with Geode Mania's darkened depths for a dangerously delectable delight!
body:
You want more maniacal foods, you got 'em.

Turn those Sculkchops from all those Scigs you chopped up into Scacon strips!
Cook it with many different recipes for even more effects.

Slay the Light Eaters that thrive in the depths of the Corrupt Geode Dimension with the Echo Greatsword using a physical strike for a new tasty hunk of meat: the Blight Thigh! Eating it cures vision-imparing effects and is more filling than even a slab of fully-cooked beef.

Make sure to grab plenty of bowls, berries, and Scacon of all kinds; only the best meals can be made with 'em...!

![Two new tea brews: Sculk Berry Tea and Berry Fusion Tea](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8430d41d9dd4152c20f1b297a35775ab7864409.png)

-- Brew 2 new nice and sweet Berry Teas, both with beneficial effects, one of the teas including Vision Guard: a new status effect that keeps your senses sharp even when inflicted with heavy Darkness, Blindness, and Nauseating effects! Both teas also grant a generous amount of XP when drank, being derived from Sculk Berries.

![The tasty Scacon & Cheggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3eb860154b9a733cc5fcc241e727c0ee43796115.png)

-- And don't forget to consume your morning Scacon & Cheggs; eating one gives you a 10% chance to give your friends a good scare when they wake up with the new Sculk Phasing effect, keeping you in full-on Spectator as long as you stay within the confines of a sculky, blocky landscape, tunneling through it just like a Warden 'till the effect expires!

By far, the best addition though... is the Echoshard Knife, which can Echo Attack AND cut food up!

NOTE: As of 7/7/2026, the 1.20.1 version of this mod has been depreciated. This mod is solely for 1.21.1+ releases of Geode Mania + Farmer's Delight, for NeoForge only.
